gold_note: Sauropod cladogram drawn as a slanted tree, 28 tips. Two trichotomies, drawn as three lines meeting at one point: Abydosaurus + Cedarosaurus + Venenosaurus, and Euhelopus + Daxiatitan + (Tangvayosaurus, Phuwiangosaurus). Europasaurus and Qiaowanlong run straight through the circles of Brachiosauridae and Euhelopodidae: each is the first-branching member of that clade. Chubutisaurus joins the backbone just below the Titanosauria circle, outside it. Joins along the backbone were checked by measuring each 45-degree line where it crosses rows of the image. Random-sample case (seed 20261106); topology only.
